title: MAX continuous ascent — twenty separate wide scene concepts
scope: Twenty separate horizontal scene concepts and nineteen neighboring connector contracts from the owner’s visual references. This candidate does not replace current runtime art, campaign profiles, collision geometry or progression.
regionIds: Existing garden-1 through garden-20 identifiers; candidate meanings only.

sources.figmaSourceType: Gallery of twenty separate horizontal concept frames with 1024-pixel-wide previews and reusable annotations. Original source PNGs are in the downloadable package; neither preview nor source is compiled/native terrain.

composition.scale: One tiny gardener and a small cart; gardener about 2.5% of scene height, consistent throughout. The architecture dominates.
composition.ports: Each scene has a physical bottom entry and top exit; consecutive exit/entry contracts share center, width, cross-section, materials, palette and spine intent. Coordinates are normalized composition targets, not measured collision or exact pixel data.
composition.overlap: Neighbor material and light overlap within each scene before the connector. The target is about 18% of local scene height around the join; retain final raster crops for future seam work.

spines.water: One connected hydraulic system. Pale source channels in upper terraces feed rivulets, marsh runoff, drains, wheel tailrace and thawing vault seepage; mark deliberate occlusion rather than inventing disconnected waterfalls.
spines.root: Roots begin in vault cracks, thread through fossils and fungus, expand into the hollow tree and bridges, then grip machinery and become summit vines.
spines.structure: Iron and masonry joints persist across regions: vault pipe, railway support, drainage work, machinery cable, aqueduct pier and greenhouse rib. Avoid a single repeated central shaft.

sky.status: native integration required; repeated baked suns/horizons in concept images are not a completed shared sky

joins.crossSection: open thawing brick service shaft with ice remaining on the left shoulder, dark iron cheeks and an attached dry maintenance shelf; no portal or doorway
joins.continuity: water spine crosses the frame at x approximately 0.62 and falls toward the frozen vault; a fine root follows the service shaft; warmer light arrives from above before the biome changes
joins.traversal: two short climbs interrupted by a broad dry maintenance landing

overlap.light: blue vault ice recedes into wet cyan reflections while warm light arrives through the open shaft before the cistern

joins.crossSection: wet-brick maintenance shaft with an iron service pipe on the right and an attached stair landing
joins.continuity: a cold trickle runs down the right service pipe into the cistern; dark roots grip wet brick cracks
joins.traversal: side climb around the cistern wall; safe return ledge beneath the rail deck

overlap.light: cistern cyan becomes station reflection before railway lamp pools increase

joins.crossSection: broken station stair throat between mossy brick piers; paired vertical lift rails and one old timber crossbeam
joins.continuity: teal drainage water follows the right lift rail into the station below; moss roots hook around the left pier
joins.traversal: descending side loop followed by an upward station stair

overlap.light: railway lamps reflect into increasingly submerged halls

joins.crossSection: broad stone spillway arch with two timber posts; shallow teal water leaves a dry attached shelf
joins.continuity: a visible teal spillway connects station floodwater to the basin; a climbing vine shares the left timber post
joins.traversal: cross a broad lip, climb two offset sluice landings

overlap.light: teal water opens gradually while dark station arches remain behind

joins.crossSection: mossy tailrace slit framed by worn hydraulic masonry and one rusted pipe
joins.continuity: wheel outflow continues down one pipe into the drainage gallery; roots remain sparse in masonry joints
joins.traversal: short horizontal compression before a tall drain climb

overlap.light: basin reflections narrow into a quieter dark tunnel

joins.crossSection: fractured drain mouth where mineral stone embraces one exposed pale rib and a dark hanging root
joins.continuity: a thin mineral seep follows the exposed rib into the old drain; hanging roots visibly continue upward
joins.traversal: three uneven shelves around a large exposed rib base

overlap.light: small seep highlights connect the drainage wall to pale buried bones

joins.crossSection: curved bone-and-root throat with unequal rib shoulders and a broad attached moss landing
joins.continuity: one thick dark root loops over the pale rib and continues through the joint; a restrained cyan seep stays on its right
joins.traversal: curving climb through a low chamber and one spacious rest pocket

overlap.light: bone highlights diminish beneath root shadow

joins.crossSection: root-framed cave opening with damp earth shoulders and tiny cyan fungi before the bright cap
joins.continuity: paired roots enter the mushroom cave and acquire small glowing fungi; one damp turquoise channel stays recessed
joins.traversal: low root passage opens into a large mushroom overlook

overlap.light: small cyan fungi precede the monumental cap

joins.crossSection: diagonal mineral fissure with a thick bark root on the left and sparse cyan mycelial veins
joins.continuity: cyan mycelial veins remain on both stone shoulders; a bark root and small water seam continue vertically
joins.traversal: diagonal route alternates attached shelf and narrow gap

overlap.light: bright cap rim gives way to sparse vein light

joins.crossSection: split tree-root throat around a dark vertical hollow; one forked root forms the attached landing
joins.continuity: mycelial veins branch into the thick tree roots; one recessed cool trickle enters the hollow
joins.traversal: two unequal root arms reconnect at a broad trunk landing

overlap.light: cyan veins enter dark bark; a warm hollow appears gradually

joins.crossSection: wide hollow branch mouth with rough bark shoulders and two braided supporting roots
joins.continuity: two braided living roots continue uninterrupted; a dark water runnel lies in the left bark groove
joins.traversal: walkable branch bends outward; small climbs lead to a bridge fork

overlap.light: hollow illumination recedes while muted ambient depth grows

joins.crossSection: root-wrapped timber-and-iron machinery anchor with one taut dark cable
joins.continuity: thick roots grip the iron anchor and cable; water follows one dark timber gutter
joins.traversal: root bridge enters machinery from below; optional anchor pocket returns safely

overlap.light: green bark shadows acquire violet distance and warm lamp anchors

joins.crossSection: counterweight service opening with two taut cables and an offset rusted platform bracket
joins.continuity: the same two taut cables cross the joint and continue into counterweights; a thin root wraps one bracket
joins.traversal: vertical counterweight climb opens into unequal suspended crossings

overlap.light: drum shadows stretch into a single violet ravine atmosphere

joins.crossSection: cable anchorage inside fractured aqueduct piers; one pale limestone arch spring remains open
joins.continuity: one black cable enters the pier; a shallow upper aqueduct water channel drains through the right notch
joins.traversal: last suspended landing reconnects to a broad grounded pier

overlap.light: distant cool ravine remains visible through incomplete stone arches

joins.crossSection: broken limestone channel joint with planted cracks, one narrow water notch and mossy retaining shoulders
joins.continuity: one narrow blue rivulet continues through the water notch while living roots occupy planted limestone cracks
joins.traversal: wide channel crossing and two varied terraced climbs

overlap.light: pale stone warms slowly as planting occupies cracks

joins.crossSection: low planted retaining lip with reed roots, dark moss and a small bronze bell stem outside the opening
joins.continuity: terrace runoff follows a dark moss groove into the reed marsh; fine reed roots bind the retaining wall

overlap.light: terrace shade becomes sage marsh haze without a fresh sky strip

joins.crossSection: pale limestone rivulet throat with reed clumps thinning out at both stone shoulders
joins.continuity: cool water descends through the limestone channel; reed roots thin into small grass roots
joins.traversal: two shallow fall crossings around a wide rest shelf

overlap.light: reeds thin out while pale limestone reflects the same ambient light

joins.continuity: the pale water channel passes between iron footings; vines continue upward along the left glazing rib
